threads.author: Stephenie Yong
threads.summary: Livit Jotform confirmation emails render dates as mm/dd/yy instead of the international dd/mm/yy format, and preferred scan time is not a required field so confirmations default to 12am.
threads.note: Both defects are logged on COP-2019; blocked on the call of whether to patch the legacy Livit form now or fold the fix into the on-contract migration - that decision sits with Ricardo and Snehal. Stephenie confirmed at 9:20 AM she is manually correcting formats in the meantime and is waiting on the update, so the next action is ours.

threads.author: Juyoung Jang
threads.summary: Capture techs cannot see Airbnb jobs in their CT Airtable views even after the job has been scheduled, so job details have to be passed over by hand. Adjet also found broken scheduling links on the host reminder emails.
threads.note: Juyoung said on 8/11 at 9:20 PM she would check with the CTs and share specific job links; still nothing received ~21 hours later, so COP-2043 cannot be narrowed past the unassigned-job theory until she sends them. Next action is hers.
